titles.title: Calla

description: Small vertical pastel of white oval shaped calla lily flower with a green stem and single leaf featured in the center over a grayish-white background.  The direction of the flower spirals away from the picture plain, hence suggesting a turning away from the viewer.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART
